candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – GIZ (ZBS) – main site
candidates.why_relevant: The national bank association is the canonical hub for Slovenian banking: member directory, sector data, standards, press releases, Bančni vestnik journal and events. Single entry point that snowballs into nearly every SI bank/savings bank/leasing actor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of section index pages (clanice, sporocila-za-javnost-in-novice, podatki-bancnega-sektorja, ustanovni-akti-in-porocila); PDF harvest for reports.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search on association name, then direct fetch of homepage navigation
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Članice (member directory of banks, savings banks and leasing companies)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the population of Slovenian banks/savings banks (~15) and leasing companies (~12) — the seed list for all issuer-level A1 disclosure collection. Observed on fetch: members rendered as logos, apparently without per-member hyperlinks, so names may need OCR/alt-text extraction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape page; extract logo alt/img filenames and captions; reconcile against Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register for canonical legal names.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Sporočila za javnost in novice (press releases, media responses, notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Sector-level position statements and 'odgovori medijem' that individual banks will not issue; on fetch the listing showed 200+ items spanning 2021–2026 with category filters (Sporočila za javnost / Odgovori medijem / Novice / Obvestilo) and year sorting — e.g. items on ECB selecting payment service providers, ESG questionnaires.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Incremental crawl of the category archive (https://www.zbs-giz.si/category/sporocila-za-javnost/) with year/category filters; store title, date, body, linked PDFs. RSS presence unconfirmed.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Ustanovni akti in poročila (statutes and annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS annual reports summarise the year's sector agenda, committee work and lobbying priorities; a compact yearly narrative of what the Slovenian banking industry cared about. A 2025 annual report PDF was surfaced in search.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull; parse text for committee/working-group names and vendor/scheme mentions.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Podatki bančnega sektorja (banking sector data)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-compiled sector aggregates (balance-sheet, network, channel data) that complement supervisory statistics and are often published earlier or in more industry-friendly cuts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl; capture XLS/PDF tables where offered.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Statistični podatki lizing dejavnost (leasing statistics)
candidates.why_relevant: Leasing is the least-covered financing segment in SI public statistics; ZBS is effectively the only aggregator, and the leasing member list identifies captive finance arms of banks and OEMs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly/annual table harvest.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Standardi in priročniki (inter-bank standards and handbooks)
candidates.why_relevant: Inter-bank technical standards and handbooks reveal the operational plumbing (payment message formats, real-estate valuation standards, AML practice) that vendors must comply with — a strong indirect signal for payments/technology procurement.
candidates.legal_status: public website; document reuse may be restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Index the page, download open PDFs, flag member-gated items.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS seznam članic sporočila za javnost

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik – revija za denarništvo in bančništvo (ZBS journal)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's flagship banking/finance journal (published by ZBS since 1952, ISSN 0005-4631, indexed in EconLit). Practitioner articles by bank executives are the richest commentary layer on payments strategy, digitalisation and regulation in Slovene.
candidates.access_status: partially gated — full texts require login/subscription
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted journal content; subscription terms apply
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest issue tables-of-contents and abstracts (open); acquire full texts via institutional subscription or COBISS library access rather than scraping the gated archive.
queries_used: Bančni vestnik revija za denarništvo in bančništvo arhiv
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results and page titles show a 'Prijava' (login) interstitial; the e-archive at info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv/prijava is described as password-protected for full texts.

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik – E-arhiv (electronic back-issue archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Deep historical run of the journal (issues back to the 1990s and earlier are referenced, e.g. a 2000-12 article on the history of Slovenian banking), giving longitudinal context on payments/banking structural change.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl issue index pages for metadata only; obtain articles legitimately via subscription/library.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search snowball from journal homepage
queries_used: Bančni vestnik revija za denarništvo in bančništvo arhiv
candidates.observed_blocker: Archive pages titled 'Prijava'; full-text access described as password-based.

candidates.source_name: COBISS+ bibliographic record for Bančni vestnik
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian union catalogue record gives authoritative bibliographic metadata (ISSN 0005-4631, publisher, run since 1952) and locates physical/library access to gated issues — a legitimate route around the paywall.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off metadata lookup; use COBISS article-level search for Bančni vestnik article titles/authors.
queries_used: Bančni vestnik revija za denarništvo in bančništvo arhiv

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Izobraževalni programi (programi.zbs-giz.si)

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech or payments-industry association was found. Searches in Slovene for a 'slovensko fintech združenje' / 'združenje za plačilne storitve' returned only blockchain/crypto bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Blockchain Think Tank Slovenija) and general chambers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenia appears to lack a standalone fintech/PSP trade association; the function is split between ZBS (banks), GZS/ZIT (ICT vendors) and DLT communities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect a single fintech member directory for SI; PSP/EMI population must be reconstructed from the Banka Slovenije register plus GZS/ZIT member lists.

negative_findings.description: Bančni vestnik full texts sit behind a login ('Prijava') and a password-protected e-archive; only metadata, article titles and some legacy items appear openly reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Journal is high value but gated; open crawling would capture only TOC-level data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget for a subscription or library access, or the richest SI-language banking commentary layer stays out of reach.

negative_findings.description: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije places its substantive trade-legislation and T-Informacije content in a member-only area (a registration/firewall path was visible in results).
negative_findings.result_summary: Merchant-side positions on card fees are likely produced but not publicly readable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The acquiring/interchange debate from the merchant perspective may be systematically under-collected without membership.

negative_findings.description: The ZBS members page renders members as logo images and, on fetch, showed no per-member hyperlinks; the transcribed names included at least one likely OCR/rendering artefact ('Lonza Bank', not a known Slovenian bank).
negative_findings.result_summary: Member names cannot be reliably extracted from that page alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any actor list derived from this page must be reconciled against the Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register before use; unreconciled names risk fabricated actors.

negative_findings.description: GZS/ZIT membership page and the GZS member register were identified by URL but their actual member enumerations were not read in this pass; ZIT board composition was only partially visible via search snippets (and the leadership names surfaced were dated ~2019).
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor-side membership data is located but not yet extracted or date-verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor mapping for the SI market remains incomplete until those pages are fetched directly.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of an RSS/Atom feed or machine-readable API on any of the association sites examined (ZBS, GZS, TZS); the ZBS press listing offers only category and year filters.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection will have to rely on HTML crawling rather than feeds.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects collector design and polling cost for the A1 workstream.

coverage_gaps.description: ZBS committees/working groups ('odbori', 'delovne skupine', e.g. for payment systems, cards, AML) were not enumerated; the Organiziranost page was located but not read in detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.zbs-giz.si/organiziranost/ and extract committee names, chairs and member institutions — the sharpest map of who drives SI payments infrastructure decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Bančni vestnik article-level index (issue TOCs, authors, abstracts) not harvested; the legacy archive host info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv was referenced only via search results and not fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt a direct fetch of the e-arhiv issue index pages to determine whether TOC/abstract layers are open; if closed, pursue COBISS/NUK article-level search or an institutional subscription.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was identified covering payment institutions, e-money institutions or card processors specifically (e.g. no SI counterpart to a national PSP association); Bankart-type scheme/processor bodies were not found in an association context in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search in Slovene for 'plačilna institucija', 'družba za izdajo elektronskega denarja', 'procesiranje kartic' combined with 'združenje'/'zbornica', and check whether processors participate through ZBS committees instead.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional chambers (GZS regional units) and the crafts chamber OZS (Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije) were not searched; OZS represents small merchants who are heavy POS/card-acceptance users.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl queries for 'Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije POS terminali provizije' and enumerate GZS regional chamber news feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Association conference and event proceedings (e.g. ZBS/Bančni vestnik annual banking conferences, 'Dan slovenskega bančništva'-type events) were not directly located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query sl for ZBS konferenca / posvet / 'Dan slovenskega bančništva' and crawl https://www.zbs-giz.si/ogled-dogodkov/ for agendas and speaker decks.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association coverage is thin by nature — only the ZBS EN mirror, AmCham and SBCA were found in English; most substantive material exists only in Slovene.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Slovene as the mandatory working language for this cell; budget for sl-language NLP/translation in the collector rather than relying on EN mirrors.

brief: Slovenia's association layer is unusually concentrated: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS, zbs-giz.si) is simultaneously the member directory for banks, savings banks and leasing firms, the sector-statistics aggregator, the inter-bank standards body, the press-release channel and the publisher of Bančni vestnik — the country's flagship banking journal since 1952. That makes ZBS the single highest-value node in this cell, with the important caveat that Bančni vestnik full texts are login-gated and the members page renders as logos rather than linked, machine-readable names. Around ZBS sit GZS and its ICT branch association ZIT for the vendor/technology side, TZS for the merchant/acceptance side (largely member-gated), and adjacent-sector associations (Slovensko zavarovalno združenje, ZDU-GIZ) that round out the financial-actor map. Notably absent is any dedicated Slovenian fintech or payment-institution association — that role is filled only partially by blockchain/DLT bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA) — so PSP and processor populations must be reconstructed from the supervisory register plus GZS/ZIT membership rather than from a single association directory.
